datasheet_identity.title: BZT52C2V0S THRU BZT52C75S SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES

extraction_notes: The target row is BZT52C30S with marking WQ. Its VZ limits are 28.0 V minimum, 30 V nominal, and 32.0 V maximum at IZT=2 mA.

The target row specifies ZZT maximum 80 Ω at IZT=2 mA, ZZK maximum 300 Ω at IZK=0.5 mA, IR maximum 0.1 µA at VR=21 V, temperature coefficient minimum 24.4 mV/°C and maximum 29.4 mV/°C, and admissible zener current IZM 2 mA, all at Ta=25 °C unless otherwise noted.
Page 1 maximum ratings specify PD maximum 200 mW, VF maximum 0.9 V at IF=10 mA, and storage and junction temperature ranges of -55 °C to +150 °C.
The Fig. 2 points are approximate digitized readings from the trace explicitly labeled 30 for the target. The plotted trace is pulsed at Ta=25 °C and is bounded by the PD=200 mW envelope.

The remaining page 3 plots were omitted because they are family-level plots without an unambiguous target-only curve or do not provide at least three unambiguous target points. Reverse recovery is not specified in the datasheet.
